fusions.name: Cold Prick
fusions.desc: A quick thrust that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Lunge
fusions.desc: Strikes from the coil, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and making the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It also deals 5% of a boss or elite target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Gathered to Strike
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom That Takes
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
